unwelcome attention in the press for its low
levels of employee satisfaction, technology
giant Sundale Systems is making changes.

as its new chief culture officer, a
position designed to address both human
resources functions and employee morale.
Ms. Lyons is a renowned workplace wellness
expert.
- [2] - As Hundrigen Health's

employee turnover by over 25 percent in just
under three years. - 3]-.

challenges," said Ms. Lyons. "My team and I

quickly as possible."

reputation in
management circles. She authors the popular
blog Satisfy Your Staff and teaches classes in
management at
Sutter
University. — [4] -
